title: More ways to make images and video
summary:
New image, video, and live transcription models landed alongside easier model browsing and less fiddly audio references.

Qwen Image 3 was added as a separate image model for generation and edits with up to three reference images. Seedance 2.5 adds four-second video generation at 480p or 720p, with optional audio and reference images for first- and last-frame control. Existing Qwen Image and Seedance models are unchanged.

The new `scribe-realtime` model accepts audio over a WebSocket and returns partial and final transcripts, with options for language, voice activity detection, and word timestamps. A separate Scribe fix makes recorded usage reflect the full input duration, including trailing silence.

ElevenMusic and Stable Audio now take `media.pollinations.ai` URLs as music references instead of multipart files; ElevenMusic handles the composition plan internally and can reuse a returned song ID. Speech reference audio now accepts publicly accessible HTTP(S) URLs beyond Pollinations media links.

highlights.title: Qwen Image 3
highlights.text: Generate images or edit them with up to three reference images using `qwen-image-3`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-image-3).

highlights.title: Seedance 2.5 video
highlights.text: Make four-second videos at 480p or 720p, with optional audio and up to two images to guide the first and last frames. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedance-2.5).

highlights.title: Scribe transcribes live
highlights.text: Stream audio to `scribe-realtime` over a WebSocket for partial and final transcripts, with optional word timestamps. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=scribe-realtime).

highlights.title: Music references by URL
highlights.text: Give ElevenMusic or Stable Audio a `media.pollinations.ai` URL in `reference_audio` instead of uploading a multipart reference file. ElevenMusic can also reuse a returned song ID through `conditioning_ref`. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Sort the model catalog
highlights.text: Sort models by newest, price, title, or brand. Search and sort stay in the URL, so you can share a filtered view or use browser back and forward. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
